questions.stem_text: Are there any limits to the application of article 103 of the UN Charter?

options.A: No, there are no limits to article 103
options.B: Yes, Article 103 cannot trump multilateral treaties
options.C: Yes, article 103 of the UN Charter cannot trump jus cogens norms
options.D: Yes, when a case is submitted to the ICJ, article 103 ceases to have any effect

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Yes, article 103 of the UN Charter cannot trump jus cogens norms

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following purposes does the 'internal point of view' play in Hart's concept
of law?

options.A: It distinguishes social rules from mere group habits.
options.C: It illustrates the authority of the legislature.
options.D: It stresses the relationship between law and justice.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - It distinguishes social rules from mere group habits.

questions.stem_text: What is the relationship between the formal sources of international law?

options.A: There is no hierarchy between the formal sources of international law
options.D: General Principles of Law supersede both custom and treaties

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - There is no hierarchy between the formal sources of international law

questions.stem_text: What does it mean for a State to be sovereign?

options.A: Sovereignty means being recognised by all other States
options.B: Sovereignty means to be able to enter into treaties and join the UN
options.C: Sovereignty means freedom to determine one's own affairs without external interference
options.D: Sovereignty means possessing the right to defend oneself

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Sovereignty means freedom to determine one's own affairs without external interference

questions.stem_text: What is the purpose of universal jurisdiction?

options.A: Its aim is to establish certain offences as universal
options.B: Its aim is to deter the commission of certain international crimes
options.C: Its aim is to provide jurisdiction to all States in respect of particular crimes
options.D: Its aim is to provide jurisdiction to all States in respect of all international crimes

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Its aim is to provide jurisdiction to all States in respect of particular crimes

questions.answer_explanation: LLM-generated false statement. Correct answer: 'It regards morals and law as inseparable.'.

questions.stem_text: The Social Fact Thesis asserts that legal systems are entirely independent of social forces and influences.
questions.answer_explanation: LLM-generated false statement. Correct answer: 'That law is essentially an artefact or social construction.'.

questions.stem_text: Social and economic rights are recognized as first generation rights alongside civil and political rights.
questions.answer_explanation: LLM-generated false statement. Correct answer: 'Civil and political rights'.

questions.stem_text: The concept of punishment is universally accepted and does not require a value-neutral definition.
questions.answer_explanation: LLM-generated false statement. Correct answer: 'Because any definition of punishment should be value-neutral.'.

questions.answer_explanation: LLM-generated false statement. Correct answer: 'Without peace everyone has a right to everything - including another's life.'.
